top_signals.title: UK Inflation Accelerates as Energy Bills Surge
top_signals.summary: UK consumer prices climbed to a four-month high after energy bills rose, ending a short period of respite for hard-pressed British households. Matt Bunny of Bloomberg Economics has the details. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: Stockland Rises Most Since 1987 as Tax Rules Favor New Builds
top_signals.summary: Shares of two of Australia’s largest property developers surged, with Stockland seeing its largest advance in about 40 years, as tax changes favoring new builds offered a potential boost to residential development.
